scope: 2026-10-15 baseline; primary-engineer provisional decisions require full caller inspection before implementation.

groups.rationale: The repeated readiness error markup can share a presenter, but each route must keep provider placement, language lookup and loading ownership.
Same readiness presenter as group 0. Verify onboarding initialization and settings-provider placement before moving markup.
Vocabulary uses the same readiness presentation while its language lookup occurs outside settings. Keep that lifecycle explicit.
SmartDeckCard and VocabularyDeckCard have matching header markup but different deck policies. Characterize actions and compact layout before sharing their presentation.
Deck action rows repeat stopPropagation, configuration and card-list controls. Verify permissions and callback meaning before a feature-local shared action row.
Compact and expanded deck cards share layout but canStart and deck fields come from different policies. Avoid a generic card with many unrelated switches.
Account sync callouts repeat one bilingual accessible login presentation in progress and leaderboard. Share the presenter while keeping visibility conditions in each route.
Both screens already compose AuthScreenShell and FormTextField. Their recovery/reset controllers and submitted fields differ. The matched shell props do not justify another form wrapper.
Password visibility and input chrome repeat across two existing RHF forms. Inspect FormTextField and focus/submit semantics before deciding on a password-field variant.
OAuthButtons already accepts the relevant string shape. Inspect passing the existing UIStrings object directly instead of copying the same five fields in both callers. Preserve distinct auth footers.
DueDateSheet is an existing identical component copied into two flashcard owners. Move one canonical feature component, preserving its controlled state and ResponsiveSheet behavior.
This is the remainder of the same duplicated DueDateSheet as group 10. One extraction must migrate both callers and remove both private copies.
Different edit sheets already reuse OverlayFooter and Button. Their save text and form policies differ; a configurable footer wrapper would add indirection for this short composition.
Qiraat block heading/body rendering is repeated between review and reader views. Share only the rendering of already-parsed blocks and preserve Arabic text, direction and typography.
RF-001 removed the copied startup-language helper. The profile database error presenter still repeats. Characterize and share presentation without changing database or language policy.
Both auth components implement the same pre-provider cached dark-theme lookup. Use one pure startup-theme owner and characterize storage errors, system media preference and native fallback.
Review settings drafts repeat in regular and smart-deck editors, but loading/reset and filter ownership differ. Characterize the draft lifecycle before a shared form or state interface.
This is draft hydration shared with group 16. Verify reset behavior, locale-specific step text and saving before combining state initialization.
Clamping and mode toggles repeat, but state lifecycle must be tested before moving callbacks into a hook. Avoid replacing the sheets with a large state container.
The two editors already share SchedulerOptionsPanel. An explicit typed prop list at each owner is normal composition, not another independent implementation of the controls.
The review-setting help overlay has identical presentation in both editors. A small feature-owned info sheet can reuse ResponsiveSheet, header and body with unchanged dismissal.
Both owners already use ActionIcon. The matched play/pause/loading expression is short and callbacks have different playback context. Another wrapper would mostly forward existing props.
The surah-name font readiness effect repeats cancellation and loaded checks. A shared font-readiness hook can own that lifecycle without editing any font asset or mapping.
Two journey branches repeat an ayah preview prefix but their content and loading behavior may differ. Inspect both complete branches and test taps/fonts before extraction.
Tafsir and translation rows share selected/download chrome but their source models and import policies differ. Inspect a shared controlled row after testing those policies.
The JSON-record fallback parser is duplicated across achievement and leaderboard boundaries. Characterize objects, arrays, invalid JSON and primitives before choosing a single pure parser.
Local review-date counts and longest-streak calculations repeat in FSRS and achievements. Share tested date policy, preserving invalid-date handling, ordering and local calendar semantics.
Missing public-review aggregate detection repeats in two clients of the same optional server contract. Share the pure error classifier without changing production schema or other failure handling.
Two smart-deck card-resolution branches repeat qiraat lookup fields. Verify prefixes, absent rows, labels and return shapes before sharing a query.
Weekly/monthly leaderboard responses use the same per-user reduction/ranking rule with different date filters. Share only the typed reduction after tie/limit/null-profile tests.
Local notes and QF sync map the same private-note fields, but malformed ranges and sync metadata need contract tests before selecting one mapping owner.
